Samir Khan: @finance my corporate card declined at Hyatt SF on 2026-02-10, paid $198.40 on personal card. Can I get reimbursed?
Nina (Finance): Sorry Samir. Submit as out-of-pocket in Concur. Attach hotel folio AND proof of personal payment (photo or statement last4). Add note 'Corp card declined at checkout'.
Samir Khan: Hotel only gave folio.pdf, no signature. Attached folio.pdf and personal-visa-4321.png
Nina (Finance): That's fine. We need manager approval. @Claire can you approve?
Claire (Manager): Approved 10 client workshop on 2/10 confirmed.
finance-bot: Ticket #EXP-2026-9121 created and assigned to Nina. ETA 3 business days.
Nina (Finance): One more: please mark payment method as 'personal' in Concur so payroll routes correctly. We'll reimburse in next payroll run or expedite ACH if urgent.
Samir Khan: Marked as out-of-pocket and added note. Can you expedite? My card's hit my statement already.
Nina (Finance): We can request ACH; reply in ticket if you want that. Closing here unless anything else.
